HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF
  LONG BEACH, CALIFORNIA AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 9, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:30 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Cindy Allen, 2nd District, Chair  Roberto Uranga, 7th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Al Austin, 8th District
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District, Vice Chair
Megan Kerr, 5th District  Anthony Taranto, Tenant Commissioner

Thomas B. Modica, Executive Director  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney
Alison King, Assistant Executive Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-52884  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Housing Authority of the City of
  Long Beach, California meeting held Tuesday, March 12, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-52885  Recommendation to receive and file the Housing Authority Financial and
  Operational Performance Reports for January 2024. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-52886  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. RFP HE-23-309 and award a contract
  to Caravana Furniture Inc, of Long Beach, CA for furnishing and delivering
  essential home furnishings and related services to program participants in our low-
  income and homeless programs in a total annual amount not to exceed $850,000,
  for a period of two years, with the option to renew for three additional one-year
  periods, at the discretion of the Housing Authority Executive Director, or designee,
  to execute all necessary documents to enter into the contract, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Thomas B. Modica, Executive Director  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney
Alison King, Assistant Executive Director

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 4:40 PM, Chair Allen called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Ricks-Oddie, Allen

 Commissioners Absent: Zendejas, Austin, Taranto

 Also present: Atoy Wilson, Deputy City Attorney, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-52884  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Housing Authority of the City of
  Long Beach, California meeting held Tuesday, March 12, 2024.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Ricks-Oddie, seconded by Commissioner
  Kerr, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Ricks-Oddie, Allen
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Zendejas, Austin, Taranto

 2.  24-52885  Recommendation to receive and file the Housing Authority Financial and
  Operational Performance Reports for January 2024. (Citywide)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Saro, seconded by Commissioner
  Uranga, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7 Duggan, Supernaw, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Ricks-Oddie, Allen
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
